text: - In order to comply with section 2.2-3712D of the Code of Virginia, it is necessary for the board to certify that since the Fairfax County School Board convened a closed meeting on September 10th, 2024, to the best of each board member's knowledge, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements and only such business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard, discussed, or considered by the board during the closed meeting.

Is there a motion? Ms. Lady, is there a second? Ms. Sizemore-Heiser, all those in favor? Mr. McDaniel, Ms. St. John Cunning, Ms. Anderson, Ms. Lady, Ms. Sizemoreheiser, Mr. Moon, and myself. That is unanimous for board members present. We are adjourned.
